'''Welding droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] which welded objects. They possessed a fairly simple intellect, which made them ideal for long, menial repair work. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], [[T3-series utility droid]]s were used for welding and [[Maintenance droid/Legends|repairs]] aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]''. One welding droid worked in [[Wald's Parts|Watto's junkyard]].
